title: Add reassuring progress note on signup page
description: Add a reassuring note on the signup page telling users their progress is safe and they can import it after signing up. This reduces anxiety about losing progress during signup.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Note appears on signup page when localStorage has anonymous progress
Note text: 'Your learning progress is saved on this device. After signing up, you'll have the option to import it to your account.'
Note styled subtly (not alarming) - info style, not warning
Note does NOT appear if no anonymous progress exists
Remove or update the 'Bring my progress' checkbox (no longer needed for auto-migration)
Verify in browser: note appears with progress, hidden without

technicalNotes: Use subtle info styling (blue/gray, not warning yellow)
Consider showing word count: 'You have X words saved on this device...'
testingNotes: Test with localStorage progress - note should appear
Test without localStorage progress - note should NOT appear
Test note styling is reassuring, not alarming
completionNotes: Added reassuring info note to signup.tsx
Note shows word and line counts from localStorage progress
Blue info icon with subtle gray/slate styling
Note only appears when hasProgressToMigrate() returns true
